---
title: "Slingshot Trajectory Analysis for cDC CITE-seq"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 6)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(SeuratWrappers)
  library(SingleCellExperiment)
  library(slingshot)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(dplyr)
})
```

## 1. Parameters

```{r parameters}
mode <- "cDC1"  # change to cDC2 or other modes if needed
seurat_path <- file.path("results", mode, "Robjects", "seurat_obj_annotated.rds")
output_dir <- file.path("results", mode, "Trajectory", "Slingshot")

dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## 2. Load Seurat object

```{r load-seurat}
if (!file.exists(seurat_path)) {
  stop("Seurat object not found: ", seurat_path)
}

seurat_obj <- readRDS(seurat_path)

if (!"author_annotation" %in% colnames(seurat_obj@meta.data)) {
  stop("Missing `author_annotation` in metadata. Please ensure annotations are loaded.")
}
```

## 3. Convert to SingleCellExperiment

```{r convert-sce}
sce <- as.SingleCellExperiment(seurat_obj)

reduction_map <- list(
  rna = "umap",
  adt = "adt_umap",
  wnn = "wnn_umap"
)

for (reduction_name in reduction_map) {
  if (!reduction_name %in% names(seurat_obj@reductions)) {
    message("Reduction not found in Seurat object: ", reduction_name)
  } else {
    reducedDims(sce)[[reduction_name]] <- Embeddings(seurat_obj, reduction_name)
  }
}
```

## 4. Slingshot helper

```{r slingshot-helper}
run_slingshot <- function(sce_obj, reduction_name, label) {
  if (!reduction_name %in% names(reducedDims(sce_obj))) {
    message("Skipping missing reduction: ", reduction_name)
    return(NULL)
  }

  message("Running Slingshot on: ", reduction_name)
  sce_obj <- slingshot(
    sce_obj,
    clusterLabels = "author_annotation",
    reducedDim = reduction_name
  )

  umap_coords <- as.data.frame(reducedDims(sce_obj)[[reduction_name]])
  colnames(umap_coords) <- c("UMAP_1", "UMAP_2")
  umap_coords$cell_id <- rownames(umap_coords)
  umap_coords$cell_type <- colData(sce_obj)$author_annotation

  plot_path <- file.path(output_dir, paste0("slingshot_", label, ".png"))
  png(plot_path, width = 1600, height = 1400, res = 200)
  plot(
    umap_coords$UMAP_1,
    umap_coords$UMAP_2,
    col = as.factor(umap_coords$cell_type),
    pch = 16,
    cex = 0.4,
    xlab = "UMAP 1",
    ylab = "UMAP 2",
    main = paste("Slingshot Trajectory -", toupper(label))
  )
  lines(SlingshotDataSet(sce_obj), lwd = 2, col = "black")
  dev.off()

  pseudotime <- as.data.frame(slingPseudotime(sce_obj))
  pseudotime$cell_id <- rownames(pseudotime)
  pseudotime$cell_type <- colData(sce_obj)$author_annotation

  pseudotime_path <- file.path(output_dir, paste0("pseudotime_", label, ".csv"))
  write.csv(pseudotime, pseudotime_path, row.names = FALSE)

  weights <- as.data.frame(slingCurveWeights(sce_obj))
  weights$cell_id <- rownames(weights)
  weights_path <- file.path(output_dir, paste0("curve_weights_", label, ".csv"))
  write.csv(weights, weights_path, row.names = FALSE)

  return(list(
    sce = sce_obj,
    plot = plot_path,
    pseudotime = pseudotime_path,
    weights = weights_path
  ))
}
```

## 5. Run Slingshot on three UMAP spaces

```{r slingshot-run}
results <- list(
  rna = run_slingshot(sce, "umap", "rna"),
  adt = run_slingshot(sce, "adt_umap", "adt"),
  wnn = run_slingshot(sce, "wnn_umap", "wnn")
)

results
```
